question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Objective
solution:
The correct answer is "**Purpose**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Objective**" generally refers to something aimed for or sought, a goal or target. (हेतु)

 
 
• **Example**- The main objective of the meeting is to align all team members on the new procedure.
 
 
 
• "**Purpose**" refers to the intended or desired result; the reason for which something is done or created. (उद्देश्य)
 
 
• **Example**- The purpose of this tool is to increase productivity.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is "Purpose".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Subjective**" signifies something based on personal feelings or opinions rather than on facts. (व्यक्तिगत)
 
• "**Tyrannical**" implies being like a tyrant; exercising power in a cruel or arbitrary way. (अत्याचारी)
 
• "**Heartfelt**" denotes deep or sincere feelings or emotions. (हृदय से)
